title: Use Inferlo's AI inside an AdonisJS app
prompt: This project also has an AdonisJS app in src/adonis/ (adonisrc.ts and start/routes.ts). Give its route handlers an AI client as ctx.ai with Inferlo's AdonisJS provider: register the provider in src/adonis/adonisrc.ts, and create src/adonis/config/ai.ts whose default export is the AI client, using an Anthropic provider (API key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable) with a "fast" alias for anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5. Then add POST /translate to src/adonis/start/routes.ts: it reads { "text": string, "to": string } from the JSON body, asks the "fast" model to translate the text into that language, and returns { "translation": <the model's text> }.
